div.div: مُضَوْضِئٌ or مُضَوْضٍ, (accord. to different copies of the K,) the former app. the original of the latter, [which is mentioned in the K in art. ضوض, but in the CK there written مَضَوْضِىٌّ,] (TA,) applied to a man, Crying out, shouting or clamouring. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
